name: request-cover
title: Request response cover sheet
for_each: select id,subject from inquiries where kind='medical'

sections.title: Request record
sections.note: Internal administrative record. No clinical content or regulatory submission.

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select r.response_ref,r.decision,r.preparer,r.reviewer,r.evidence,s.title,s.version,s.reference,s.valid_until,s.withdrawn from reviews r join sources s on s.id=r.source_id where r.inquiry_id=$1

sections.title: Record events
sections.sql: select action,actor,reference,created_at from events where inquiry_id=$1 order by created_at,id
